name: Linen key board
description: The rooms hanging as keys from a rail, each fob dyed in its room's color with its number and name, swinging in turn as the board comes into view and one by one under the pointer; under each key the room's picture, name, facts and price from a night. Each room has its own page, dyed in its color, with its large key, its facts and pictures, and the other rooms.
